newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Philippine LD upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Philippine LD upped.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan analysts David Barden and Agnes Ho on Friday raised their rating for Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co to buy from market performer.
-- In a report, they wrote that "key uncertainties" that had hindered or blurred the company's earnings performance had been addressed.
-- The shares trade at a discount to other Philippine blue chips and comparable regional telecommunications carriers.
-- The company's 1996 net profit was seven percent ahead of the analysts' estimates.
-- American Depositary Receipts in the company were up 1-1/4 to 61-1/8 at midday.
